# SSU Australia

> SSU Australia is an Australian food startup platform and the home of branded local kitchens.

Brand philosophy: Serve Something Unique.

SSU Australia helps cooks, chefs, home kitchens and existing food businesses launch a branded local kitchen, create a menu and prepare to sell through local pickup and delivery. The initial focus is Ballina and the Northern Rivers, NSW, Australia.

## Key topics

- Starting a food business in Australia
- Food startups in Ballina and the Northern Rivers
- Branded local kitchens
- Home kitchen businesses
- Chef-led food brands
- Restaurant secondary brands and new menu testing
- Founding Kitchens
